[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
He was the son of [[Glasgow-3920|Patrick Glasgow]].  Richard Glasco died on 1 November 1738 aged 10. His brother James later erected the Kilclone memorial, which also names their brother William and their father Patrick.
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3920]] is assessed at 99% (proved). The Kilclone memorial explicitly names Richard as James’s brother and Patrick’s son, with death 1 November 1738 aged 10. Father-3920 is exactly that memorial Patrick, died May 1754 aged 60.

Memorial-defined father and son; Richard’s calculated 1728 birth conflicts with c 1720 field but does not weaken kinship.

Next useful test: Compare 1892 transcription with stone photograph for exact age and punctuation.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-3925 Association for the Preservation of the Memorials of the Dead in Ireland,]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
